remarks: Turnkey Retail / Restaurant Opportunity - Norwalk, CT  Exceptional opportunity for restaurateurs, retailers, or service-oriented users. This freestanding building is fully built out as a restaurant and features both front and rear entrances, along with a private parking lot.  Located in a high-traffic retail corridor adjacent to Starbucks, Stew Leonard's, and other major national retailers, the property offers excellent visibility and strong co-tenancy.  Property Highlights: Fully built-out restaurant / cafe space Freestanding building with private parking Patio seating for up to 30 guests Bright, open layout with large storefront windows Finished ceilings with approximately 18' height Central air conditioning and heating Private restrooms Space in excellent condition
